title: Chosen for a Purpose
story:
A school was preparing for its annual music concert.

The teacher handed out instruments to each student.

Most of the children quickly picked the shiny, popular instruments.

One small, worn violin remained on the table.

A quiet boy thought,

“No one wants that one.”

The teacher smiled and placed the violin in his hands.

“This instrument may not look impressive,” she said,

“but in the right hands, it can produce beautiful music.”

The boy practiced faithfully every day.

On the night of the concert, the beautiful melody from that old violin touched everyone's hearts.

People applauded with joy.

The value had never been in the appearance of the instrument, but in the one who used it.

God often chooses people the world overlooks.

He delights in showing His power through ordinary lives.

When we place ourselves in His hands, He can accomplish far more than we ever imagined.
life_lesson: God delights in using ordinary people to accomplish extraordinary purposes for His glory.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for choosing me, even when I feel weak or insignificant.

Help me not to compare myself with others.

Instead, teach me to trust that You can use my life for Your glory.

May I remain faithful in whatever You have called me to do.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Have you ever felt that you were not good enough?

How does knowing that God chooses ordinary people encourage you today?

How can you allow Him to use your gifts for His glory?
verse: But God chose the foolish things of the world to shame the wise; God chose the weak things of the world to shame the strong.
